definitions.documentation: Shopify Create Product. Fixed Admin GraphQL 2026-10 document. Scope: write_products. Requires create-products permission. Creates initial variant only; 50,000-variant stores can have additional daily throttles. One call only; cursor pages 1..100; no automatic pagination/retry. Confirm mutation explicitly. Profile uses config.shopDomain and credentials.accessToken; fallback named SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN secret. Errors omit private messages; inspect outcome, userErrors paths and GraphQL error codes. Network failure can leave mutation outcome uncertain. Response/request bounds and total 100..30000ms deadline include credential lookup and decoding. No token acquisition or live provider verification. definitions.code: function bounded(v){const stack=[[v,0,false]],active=new Set();let count=0;while(stack.length){const [x,d,exit]=stack.pop();if(exit){active.delete(x);continue;}if(d>90||++count>200000)throw Error('Value complexity bound');if(x===null||typeof x==='string'||typeof x==='boolean')continue;if(typeof x==='number'&&Number.isFinite(x))continue;if(!x||typeof x!=='object'||active.has(x)||!Array.isArray(x)&&![Object.prototype,null].includes(Object.getPrototypeOf(x)))throw Error('Finite acyclic JSON required');active.add(x);stack.push([x,d,true]);for(const y of Array.isArray(x)?x:Object.values(x))stack.push([y,d+1,false]);}if(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(v))>1048576)throw Error('Value exceeds 1 MiB');return v;}const value=bounded(inputs.value),fields=["data","errors","outcome","cost","apiVersion"],aliases={"data":"data","errors":"errors","outcome":"outcome","cost":"cost","apiVersion":"apiVersion"},out=Object.create(null);for(const k of fields)if(Object.hasOwn(value,k))out[aliases[k]]=value[k];return out;

definitions.documentation: Shopify Set Metafields. Fixed Admin GraphQL 2026-10 document. Scope: Write scope/permissions for owner resource. Atomic Shopify operation; compareDigest required here (null asserts absence; otherwise use fetched digest). Owner type must implement HasMetafields and caller must have appropriate access. One call only; cursor pages 1..100; no automatic pagination/retry. Confirm mutation explicitly. Profile uses config.shopDomain and credentials.accessToken; fallback named SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN secret. Errors omit private messages; inspect outcome, userErrors paths and GraphQL error codes. Network failure can leave mutation outcome uncertain. Response/request bounds and total 100..30000ms deadline include credential lookup and decoding. No token acquisition or live provider verification.
